instructions: Step 1: Preheat Oven
Preheat the oven to 180°C and lightly grease a baking dish with 1 tsp olive oil.

Slice 200g zucchini and 200g eggplant into thin rounds, then toss with 1 tsp olive oil.

Heat 200ml tomato sauce in a saucepan with 1 tsp oregano, simmering for 5 minutes.

Spread a thin layer of tomato sauce in the baking dish, add 3–4 lasagna sheets, then layer with ricotta, roasted vegetables, and more sauce. Repeat for 2–3 layers.

instructions: Step 1: Preheat Oven
Preheat the oven to 180°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Step 2: Prepare Vegetables
Grate 200g zucchini and 150g carrots, then squeeze out excess moisture using a clean cloth.
Step 3: Mix Kofta Batter
In a bowl, combine grated vegetables, 50g chickpea flour, 1 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp black pepper.
Step 4: Form Kofta Balls
Shape the mixture into 10–12 small balls, about 1 inch in diameter, and place on the baking sheet.
Step 5: Brush with Oil
Lightly brush the kofta balls with 1 tbsp olive oil for a golden finish.
Step 6: Bake Kofta
Bake for 25–30 minutes, turning halfway, until firm and lightly browned.
Step 7: Prepare Yogurt Sauce
In a small bowl, mix 100g Greek yogurt with 1 tsp lemon juice, 1/4 tsp garlic powder, and a pinch of salt.
Step 8: Serve
Arrange kofta on a plate, drizzle with yogurt sauce, garnish with 1 tsp chopped cilantro if desired, and serve warm as a flavorful dinner.

instructions: Step 1: Preheat Oven
Preheat the oven to 180°C and grease a 9x13-inch baking dish with 1 tsp olive oil.

Wash and dice 300g mixed vegetables (e.g., bell peppers, zucchini, onions) into small pieces.

Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat, add vegetables and 200g rinsed black beans, and sauté for 5–7 minutes until softened.

Stir in 1 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp chili powder, cooking for 1–2 minutes to blend flavors.

Warm 4 tortillas (corn or flour) briefly to make them pliable.
Step 6: Assemble Enchiladas
Place 2 tbsp of the vegetable-bean mixture and 1 tbsp shredded cheese (from 150g total) on each tortilla, roll tightly, and place seam-side down in the baking dish.

Pour 200ml enchilada sauce over the rolled tortillas, sprinkle the remaining cheese on top, and bake for 25–30 minutes until bubbly and golden.
Step 8: Serve
Let cool for 5 minutes, garnish with 1 tsp chopped cilantro if desired, and serve warm as a hearty dinner.

instructions: Step 1: Preheat Oven
Preheat the oven to 180°C and grease a 9x13-inch baking dish with 1 tsp olive oil.
Step 2: Prepare Eggplant
Slice 400g eggplant into 1/4-inch rounds, sprinkle with 1/2 tsp salt, and let sit for 15 minutes to release moisture, then pat dry.

Peel and slice 200g potatoes into 1/4-inch rounds, then boil for 5–7 minutes until slightly tender, and drain.
Step 4: Cook Lentils
Rinse 200g lentils, cook in 400ml water with 1 tsp cumin and 1/2 tsp paprika for 20 minutes until tender, then drain.
Step 5: Sauté Eggplant
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet, fry eggplant slices for 2–3 minutes per side until golden, and set aside.
Step 6: Make Béchamel
In a saucepan, melt 1 tbsp butter, whisk in 1 tbsp flour, then slowly add 200ml milk, stirring until thickened. Season with 1/4 tsp nutmeg and 1/4 tsp salt.

Layer potatoes, lentils, and eggplant in the baking dish, repeating until used up. Pour béchamel over the top, spreading evenly.
Step 8: Bake and Serve
Bake for 50 minutes until golden and bubbly. Let cool for 10 minutes, garnish with 1 tsp chopped parsley if desired, and serve warm as a hearty dinner.

instructions: Step 1: Preheat Oven
Preheat the oven to 180°C and lightly grease a 9x13-inch baking dish with 1 tsp olive oil.
Step 2: Cook Pasta Shells
Boil 15 jumbo pasta shells in salted water for 8–10 minutes until al dente, then drain and cool slightly.
Step 3: Prepare Spinach
Wash 150g spinach, chop roughly, and sauté in 1 tsp olive oil for 2–3 minutes until wilted, then cool.
Step 4: Mix Filling
In a bowl, combine 250g ricotta, sautéed spinach, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/4 tsp black pepper until smooth.
Step 5: Stuff Shells
Spoon about 1–2 tbsp of the ricotta-spinach mixture into each pasta shell, filling generously.
Step 6: Spread Marinara
Pour 100ml marinara sauce into the bottom of the baking dish, place stuffed shells on top, and drizzle with remaining 100ml marinara.
Step 7: Add Cheese Topping
Sprinkle 50g shredded mozzarella over the shells for a cheesy finish.
Step 8: Bake and Serve
Bake for 25–30 minutes until bubbly and golden. Let cool for 5 minutes, garnish with 1 tsp chopped basil if desired, and serve warm as a rich dinner.

instructions: Step 1: Prepare Vegetables
Wash and dice 200g mixed vegetables (e.g., bell peppers, onions, zucchini) into small pieces.

Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.

Add mixed vegetables to the skillet and sauté for 5–7 minutes until softened and slightly golden.

Separate 6 eggs to collect the whites (or use 180ml liquid egg whites) in a bowl.

Whisk 1/4 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp black pepper into the egg whites for flavor.

Pour egg whites into the skillet with the vegetables, stirring gently for 3–4 minutes until just set.

Taste and add a pinch of paprika (optional) for a smoky kick, if desired.

Transfer the scramble to a plate, garnish with 1 tsp chopped parsley if desired, and serve warm as a light breakfast.

instructions: Step 1: Gather the Ingredients:

Collect 3 tbsp butter, 1 chopped onion, 1 cup tomato puree, 2 tbsp cashew paste, 1 tsp red chili powder, 1 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp salt, 200g paneer (cubed), ¼ cup cream, 2 cups flour, water for dough, and extra butter for cooking.
Step 2: Heat the Butter:
Melt 2 tbsp butter in a pan over medium heat for 1-2 minutes until it’s fully melted and hot.
Step 3: Sauté the Onions:
Add 1 chopped onion and sauté for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until golden brown.
Step 4: Cook the Base:
Stir in 1 cup tomato puree, 2 tbsp cashew paste, 1 tsp red chili powder, 1 tsp garam masala, and 1 tsp salt, cooking for 5 minutes until the mixture thickens.
Step 5: Add Paneer and Cream:
Mix in 200g paneer cubes and ¼ cup cream, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring gently to coat the paneer.
Step 6: Prepare the Dough:
In a bowl, knead 2 cups flour with water into a soft dough, then divide into 4-6 balls for lachha parathas.
Step 7: Roll and Cook the Paratha:
Roll each dough ball into a thin circle, brush with butter, fold into layers, roll again, and cook on a hot pan with 1 tsp butter per side for 2-3 minutes until golden and flaky.
Step 8: Serve Hot:
Plate the creamy shahi paneer and serve with the hot, buttery lachha paratha for a rich, royal meal.

recipeName: Homemade Soya Bean Kebab with Yogurt
instructions: Step 1: Gather the Ingredients:

Collect 1 cup soya granules, 1 boiled mashed potatoes, 1 chopped onion, 2 green chilies (chopped), 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste, 1 tsp red chili powder, 1 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp salt, 3 tbsp oil, and plain yogurt for serving.
Step 2: Soak the Soya Granules:
Place 1 cup soya granules in a bowl, cover with warm water, soak for 10 minutes, then drain and squeeze out excess water.
Step 3: Prepare the Mixture:

In a bowl, combine the soaked soya granules, 2 mashed potatoes, 1 chopped onion, 2 chopped green chilies, 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste, 1 tsp red chili powder, 1 tsp garam masala, and 1 tsp salt, mixing well.
Step 4: Shape the Kebabs:
Take small portions of the mixture and shape into round or oval kebabs, pressing firmly to ensure they hold together.
Step 5: Heat the Oil:
Pour 3 tbsp oil into a frying pan and heat over medium heat for 2-3 minutes until hot.
Step 6: Shallow Fry the Kebabs:
Place the kebabs in the pan and fry for 4-5 minutes on each side until golden brown and crispy.
Step 7: Check for Doneness:
Ensure the kebabs are cooked through and have a firm, golden exterior; remove from the pan and drain on paper towels.
Step 8: Serve with Yogurt:
Plate the hot soya bean kebabs and serve with a side of plain yogurt for a light, savory meal.

recipeName: Creamy Dal Makhni with Buttered Roti
instructions: Step 1: Gather the Ingredients:

Collect 1 cup whole black lentils (urad dal), ¼ cup kidney beans (rajma), 3 tbsp butter, 1 chopped onion, 2 garlic cloves (minced), 1 tbsp ginger paste, 1 cup tomato puree, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp cumin seeds, ½ cup cream, 2 cups whole wheat flour, water for dough, and extra butter for garnish and roti.
Step 2: Soak and Boil Lentils: Soak 1 cup black lentils and ¼ cup kidney beans overnight, then boil in 4 cups water for 45-60 minutes until soft, and set aside.
Step 3: Heat the Butter: Melt 3 tbsp butter in a pan over medium heat for 1-2 minutes until it’s hot and fragrant.
Step 4: Sauté the Aromatics: Add 1 chopped onion, 2 minced garlic cloves, and 1 tbsp ginger paste, sautéing for 5-7 minutes until the onions turn golden.
Step 5: Cook the Tomato Base: Stir in 1 cup tomato puree and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it thickens and blends with the aromatics.
Step 6: Add Lentils and Spices: Mix in the boiled lentils and kidney beans, 1 tsp salt, and 1 tsp cumin seeds, stirring well to combine.
Step 7: Simmer with Cream: Pour in ½ cup cream, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the dal becomes creamy and rich.

Step 8: Serve with Buttered Roti: Knead 2 cups whole wheat flour with water into dough, roll into rotis, cook on a tawa with butter for 1-2 minutes per side, garnish dal with a pat of butter, and serve hot.

instructions: Step 1: Gather Ingredients:
Collect 4 cups khoya (crumbled), ¾ cup sugar, ½ tsp cardamom powder, 2 tbsp almonds (slivered), 1 tsp ghee (for greasing), and 1 tbsp milk (optional, for smoothness).
Step 2: Prepare Tray:
Grease a square tray or plate with 1 tsp ghee and set aside for setting the barfi.
Step 3: Crumble Khoya:
In a non-stick pan, crumble 2 cups khoya finely to ensure even cooking.
Step 4: Cook Khoya:
Heat the pan over low-medium heat, add the crumbled khoya, and stir continuously for 5-7 minutes until it softens and melts slightly.
Step 5: Add Sugar and Flavor:
Mix in ¾ cup sugar and ½ tsp cardamom powder, stirring for 8-10 minutes until the mixture thickens, starts leaving the pan’s sides, and becomes a dough-like consistency; add 1 tbsp milk if too dry.
Step 6: Set Barfi:
Pour the mixture into the greased tray, spread evenly with a spatula, and sprinkle 2 tbsp slivered almonds on top, pressing lightly to adhere.
Step 7: Cool and Cut:
Let the barfi cool at room temperature for 1-2 hours until set, then cut into squares and serve.

instructions: Step 1: Prepare Marinade
In a bowl, whisk 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tsp olive oil, 1 minced garlic clove, 1/4 tsp salt, and 1/4 tsp black pepper.
Step 2: Marinate Chicken
Place 150g chicken breast in the marinade, coat well, and let sit for 10 minutes.
Step 3: Preheat Grill
Heat a grill pan or outdoor grill to medium-high heat and lightly oil the surface.
Step 4: Grill Chicken
Grill chicken for 5–6 minutes per side until cooked through (internal temp 165°F/74°C), then rest for 5 minutes.
Step 5: Prepare Avocado
Cut ½ avocado (~70g) in half, remove the pit, scoop out the flesh, and slice thinly.
Step 6: Prepare Greens
Wash 50g mixed greens (e.g., spinach, arugula) and place in a serving bowl as the salad base.
Step 7: Slice Chicken
Slice the rested chicken breast into thin strips for easy eating.
Step 8: Assemble and Serve
Top greens with chicken slices and avocado, drizzle with 1 tsp lemon juice if desired, and serve immediately as a light lunch.

instructions: Step 1: Prepare Tuna
Drain 120g canned tuna (in water) and place in a mixing bowl.
Step 2: Make Dressing
In a small bowl, combine 2 tbsp Greek yogurt, 1/2 tsp chili flakes, and a pinch of salt.
Step 3: Mix Tuna Filling
Add the yogurt mixture to the tuna, stirring until well combined.

Finely dice 50g cucumber and add to the tuna mixture for extra crunch.

Wash 4 large lettuce leaves (e.g., romaine or butter lettuce) and pat dry carefully.

Divide the tuna mixture evenly, spooning about 2 tbsp into the center of each lettuce leaf.

Sprinkle 1 tsp chopped cilantro or a squeeze of lemon juice over the filling for freshness, if desired.
Step 8: Serve
Fold or roll the lettuce leaves around the filling and serve immediately as a light snack.

instructions: Step 1: Prepare Lamb
Trim 250g lamb (e.g., shoulder or leg) and cut into 1-inch cubes.
Step 2: Prepare Onion
Peel and finely chop 50g onion for aromatic flavor.
Step 3: Heat Oil
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Step 4: Brown Lamb
Add lamb cubes to the pot, season with 1/4 tsp salt, and brown for 5–7 minutes, then remove and set aside.
Step 5: Sauté Onion
In the same pot, add onion and sauté for 3–4 minutes until soft and golden.
Step 6: Add Rice and Spices
Rinse 100g basmati rice, add to the pot with 1 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp cinnamon, and 1/4 tsp black pepper, stirring for 1–2 minutes to toast.
Step 7: Simmer Pilaf
Return lamb to the pot, pour in 200ml chicken broth plus 100ml water, bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer, cover, and cook for 30–35 minutes until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Step 8: Serve
Fluff the pilaf with a fork, garnish with 1 tsp chopped parsley if desired, and serve warm as a hearty dinner.

instructions: Step 1: Prepare Turkey
Finely chop 80g cooked turkey (e.g., deli or leftover) into small pieces.
Step 2: Prepare Spinach
Wash 50g spinach thoroughly and chop roughly if leaves are large.

Crack 3 eggs into a bowl, whisk with a fork until well combined, and season with 1/4 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp black pepper.

Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.

Add spinach to the skillet and sauté for 1–2 minutes until wilted, then remove and set aside.

Add chopped turkey to the skillet, warming for 1–2 minutes until heated through.

Pour eggs into the skillet, add spinach back, and cook for 3–4 minutes, lifting edges to let uncooked egg flow underneath, until set.
Step 8: Serve
Fold the omelette in half, slide onto a plate, garnish with 1 tsp chopped chives if desired, and serve warm as a light breakfast.

Remove foil, sprinkle 1 tsp chopped parsley if desired, and serve warm as a hearty dinner.

instructions: Step 1: Preheat Oven
Preheat the oven to 180°C and prepare a baking dish lightly greased with ½ tsp olive oil.
Step 2: Prepare Tomatoes
Cut the tops off 4 medium tomatoes (about 100g each), scoop out the seeds and pulp with a spoon, and reserve pulp for another use.
Step 3: Cook Beef
Heat ½ tsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat, add 100g ground beef, and cook for 4–5 minutes, breaking it apart until browned.
Step 4: Season Beef
Add ¼ tsp salt, ¼ tsp black pepper, and ½ tsp paprika to the beef, stirring for 1 minute, then remove from heat.
Step 5: Scramble Eggs
In a bowl, whisk 3 eggs with a pinch of salt, then scramble in the same skillet over low heat for 2–3 minutes until just set.
Step 6: Combine Filling
Mix the scrambled eggs with the cooked beef in a bowl, ensuring an even blend.
Step 7: Stuff Tomatoes
Spoon the egg-beef mixture evenly into the hollowed tomatoes, packing lightly, and place in the baking dish.
Step 8: Bake and Serve
Bake for 18–20 minutes until tomatoes are tender, garnish with 1 tsp chopped parsley if desired, and serve warm as a light breakfast.

instructions: Step 1: Cook Pasta
Bring a pot of water to a boil, add 100g whole-wheat pasta, and cook for 8–10 minutes until al dente, then drain and set aside.
Step 2: Prepare Salmon
Pat 200g salmon fillet dry, season with ¼ tsp salt and ¼ tsp black pepper.
Step 3: Cook Salmon
Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat, cook salmon for 3–4 minutes per side until it flakes easily, then set aside to cool slightly.
Step 4: Flake Salmon
Using a fork, gently flake the salmon into bite-sized pieces, removing any skin or bones.
Step 5: Prepare Spinach
Wash 100g spinach leaves, then wilt in the same skillet over low heat for 1–2 minutes until soft, and remove from heat.
Step 6: Make Cream Sauce
In the skillet, add 50ml light cream, 1 minced garlic clove, and ½ tsp lemon zest, stirring over low heat for 2 minutes until slightly thickened.
Step 7: Combine Ingredients
Add pasta, flaked salmon, and spinach to the sauce, tossing gently to coat evenly.
Step 8: Serve
Plate the pasta, garnish with 1 tsp chopped parsley if desired, and serve warm as a hearty dinner.

instructions: Step 1: Prepare Beef
Cut 150g beef sirloin into ½-inch cubes and pat dry with a paper towel.
Step 2: Chop Onion
Finely chop 50g onion for even cooking and flavor.
Step 3: Heat Oil
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Step 4: Sauté Beef
Add beef cubes to the skillet, sauté for 3–4 minutes until browned, then remove and set aside.
Step 5: Sauté Onion
In the same skillet, add chopped onion, sauté for 2–3 minutes until soft and translucent.
Step 6: Scramble Eggs
Crack 3 eggs into a bowl, whisk with ¼ tsp salt and ¼ tsp black pepper, then pour into the skillet with onions, stirring gently.
Step 7: Combine Ingredients
Return beef to the skillet, stir with eggs and onions for 1–2 minutes until eggs are fully cooked and scrambled.
Step 8: Serve
Season with ½ tsp paprika if desired, garnish with 1 tsp chopped parsley, and serve hot as a hearty breakfast.

instructions: Step 1: Preheat Oven
Preheat the oven to 180°C and prepare a baking dish lightly greased with 1 tsp olive oil.
Step 2: Prepare Tomatoes
Cut the tops off 4 tomatoes (~100g each), scoop out seeds and pulp with a spoon, reserving pulp for another use.
Step 3: Cook Couscous
Bring 150ml water to a boil, add 100g couscous, cover, remove from heat, and let sit for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Step 4: Cook Lamb
Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat, add 200g ground lamb, and cook for 5–6 minutes, breaking it apart until browned.
Step 5: Season Mixture
Add 1 minced garlic clove, 5g chopped mint, ½ tsp cumin, and ¼ tsp salt to the lamb, stirring for 1 minute, then remove from heat.
Step 6: Combine Filling
In a bowl, mix cooked couscous, lamb mixture, and 1 tbsp chopped parsley until well combined.
Step 7: Stuff Tomatoes
Spoon the lamb-couscous mixture evenly into the hollowed tomatoes, packing lightly, and place in the baking dish.
Step 8: Bake and Serve
Bake for 20–25 minutes until tomatoes are tender, garnish with a sprinkle of mint if desired, and serve warm as a flavorful dinner.

instructions: Step 1: Cook Quinoa
Rinse 100g quinoa, cook in 200ml water over medium heat for 12–15 minutes until tender, then drain and cool slightly.
Step 2: Prepare Salmon
Pat 180g salmon fillet dry, season with ¼ tsp salt and ¼ tsp black pepper.
Step 3: Grill Salmon
Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a grill pan over medium heat, grill salmon for 3–4 minutes per side until it flakes easily, then set aside to cool.
Step 4: Flake Salmon
Using a fork, gently flake the salmon into bite-sized pieces, removing any skin or bones.
Step 5: Prepare Tomatoes
Halve 100g cherry tomatoes and set aside.
Step 6: Make Dressing
In a small bowl, whisk 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tsp olive oil, ½ tsp Dijon mustard, and a pinch of salt until combined.
Step 7: Toss Salad
In a large bowl, combine quinoa, flaked salmon, cherry tomatoes, and lemon dressing, tossing gently to coat.
Step 8: Serve
Divide salad into portions, garnish with 1 tsp chopped parsley if desired, and serve chilled or at room temperature as a light lunch.

Spread the turkey-vegetable mixture in the baking dish, top evenly with mashed sweet potatoes.
Step 8: Bake and Serve
Bake for 25–30 minutes until golden, let rest for 5 minutes, garnish with 1 tsp chopped parsley if desired, and serve warm as a hearty dinner.

instructions: Step 1: Preheat Oven
Preheat the oven to 190°C and lightly grease a baking dish with 1 tsp olive oil.
Step 2: Prepare Sweet Potatoes
Peel and chop 400g sweet potatoes into chunks, boil in water for 15 minutes until soft, then drain.
Step 3: Mash Sweet Potatoes
Mash sweet potatoes with 1 tbsp milk (or water) and ¼ tsp black pepper until smooth, then set aside.
Step 4: Cook Beef
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat, add 300g ground beef, and cook for 5–6 minutes until browned, breaking it apart.
Step 5: Add Vegetables
Add 100g diced carrots, 100g peas, and 1 minced garlic clove to the beef, cooking for 4–5 minutes until vegetables soften.
Step 6: Season Filling
Stir in ½ tsp thyme, ¼ tsp salt, and 100ml beef broth, simmering for 5 minutes until slightly thickened.
Step 7: Assemble Pie
Spread the beef-vegetable mixture in the baking dish, top evenly with mashed sweet potatoes, smoothing with a spatula.
Step 8: Bake and Serve
Bake for 25–30 minutes until golden, let rest for 5 minutes, garnish with 1 tsp chopped parsley if desired, and serve warm as a hearty dinner.

instructions: Step 1: Prepare Salmon
Chop 80g smoked salmon into small pieces and set aside.
Step 2: Chop Chives
Finely chop 5g fresh chives, reserving a pinch for garnish.
Step 3: Whisk Eggs
Crack 4 eggs into a bowl, whisk with ¼ tsp salt and ¼ tsp black pepper until well combined.
Step 4: Heat Pan
Melt 1 tbsp butter in a non-stick skillet over medium-low heat, ensuring it coats the pan evenly.
Step 5: Cook Omelette
Pour eggs into the skillet, swirling to spread evenly, and cook for 2–3 minutes until edges begin to set.
Step 6: Add Fillings
Sprinkle smoked salmon and most of the chives over one half of the omelette.
Step 7: Fold and Finish
Cook for 1–2 minutes more until eggs are just set, fold the omelette in half over the filling, and slide onto a plate.
Step 8: Serve
Garnish with reserved chives, and serve immediately as a light breakfast.

instructions: Step 1: Preheat Oven
Preheat the oven to 180°C and lightly grease a deep baking dish with 1 tsp olive oil.
Step 2: Prepare Eggplant
Slice 300g eggplant into ¼-inch rounds, sprinkle with ¼ tsp salt, and let sit for 15 minutes to release moisture, then pat dry.
Step 3: Cook Eggplant
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat, cook eggplant slices for 2–3 minutes per side until golden, then set aside.
Step 4: Cook Lamb
In the same skillet, add 350g ground lamb and 50g chopped onion, cooking for 5–6 minutes until lamb is browned, breaking it apart.
Step 5: Season Lamb
Add 1 minced garlic clove, ½ tsp cinnamon, ½ tsp oregano, and 100ml tomato puree to the lamb, simmering for 5 minutes, then set aside.
Step 6: Prepare Potatoes
Peel and slice 200g potatoes into ¼-inch rounds, boil for 5 minutes until slightly tender, then drain.
Step 7: Assemble Moussaka
Layer potatoes in the baking dish, followed by half the eggplant, all the lamb mixture, remaining eggplant, and top with 200ml béchamel sauce.
Step 8: Bake and Serve
Bake for 40–45 minutes until golden and bubbly, let rest for 10 minutes, garnish with 1 tsp chopped parsley, and serve warm as a rich dinner.

instructions: Step 1: Prepare Avocado
Halve ½ avocado (~70g), remove the pit, scoop out the flesh, and mash with ½ tsp lemon juice.

Wash 30g spinach leaves, pat dry, and remove any tough stems.

Optionally, warm 1 whole-grain wrap in a dry skillet for 10–15 seconds to make it pliable.

Spread mashed avocado evenly over the entire surface of the wrap.

Layer turkey slices and spinach over the avocado, covering about two-thirds of the wrap.

Tightly roll the wrap from the filled side, tucking in the edges as you go, then slice in half diagonally.
Step 8: Serve
Place wrap halves on a plate, sprinkle with a pinch of black pepper if desired, and serve fresh as a quick lunch.

instructions: Step 1: Prepare Ingredients
Slice 200g mushrooms thinly, cut 250g beef tenderloin into ½-inch cubes, and finely chop 50g onion.
Step 2: Cook Beef
Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat, sear beef cubes for 2–3 minutes until browned, then remove and set aside.
Step 3: Sauté Mushrooms
In the same skillet, add 1 tsp olive oil, sauté mushrooms for 4–5 minutes until golden, then remove and set aside.
Step 4: Sauté Aromatics
In a large pot, heat 1 tbsp olive oil, add onion and 1 minced garlic clove, sauté for 2–3 minutes until softened.
Step 5: Toast Rice
Add 150g Arborio rice to the pot, stirring for 1–2 minutes until lightly toasted.
Step 6: Cook Risotto
Gradually add 800ml warm beef broth, 100ml at a time, stirring constantly, letting each addition absorb before adding more, for about 20–25 minutes until rice is creamy and al dente.
Step 7: Combine Ingredients
Stir in beef, mushrooms, 40g grated parmesan, and ½ tsp thyme, cooking for 2 minutes to heat through.
Step 8: Serve
Season with ¼ tsp black pepper, garnish with 1 tsp chopped parsley, and serve hot as a creamy dinner.

recipeName: Lamb and Rice Stuffed Grape Leaves
instructions: Step 1: Prepare Rice
Rinse 150g rice under cold water, soak in warm water for 10 minutes, then drain and set aside.
Step 2: Cook Lamb
Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat, add 250g ground lamb, and cook for 4–5 minutes until browned, breaking it apart.
Step 3: Mix Filling
In a bowl, combine lamb, rice, 5g chopped mint, ½ tsp allspice, ¼ tsp salt, and ¼ tsp black pepper, mixing thoroughly.
Step 4: Prepare Grape Leaves
Rinse 20 grape leaves (jarred or fresh) in cold water, pat dry, and trim any tough stems.
Step 5: Roll Leaves
Place a grape leaf shiny-side down, add ~1 tbsp filling near the stem, fold sides over, and roll tightly into a small cylinder; repeat for all leaves.
Step 6: Arrange in Pot
Line a pot with a few grape leaves, arrange rolls seam-side down in tight layers, and drizzle with 1 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tsp olive oil.
Step 7: Steam Rolls
Add 500ml water to cover rolls, place a plate on top to weigh down, cover, and simmer on low for 50–60 minutes until rice is tender.
Step 8: Serve
Carefully remove rolls, let cool slightly, garnish with 1 tsp chopped parsley, and serve warm or at room temperature as a flavorful dinner.

instructions: Step 1: Preheat Oven
Preheat oven to 200°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Step 2: Prepare Chicken
Pat dry 200g chicken thighs, rub with 1 tsp olive oil, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, and ¼ tsp salt.
Step 3: Prepare Vegetables
Slice 100g bell peppers into strips, toss with 1 tsp olive oil and a pinch of black pepper.
Step 4: Roast Chicken and Veggies
Place chicken and peppers on the baking sheet, roast for 20–25 minutes until chicken reaches 165°F/74°C and peppers are tender.
Step 5: Prepare Chickpeas
Drain and rinse 100g canned chickpeas, toss with ½ tsp cumin and a pinch of salt, then roast for 10 minutes alongside chicken.
Step 6: Slice Chicken
Remove chicken from oven, let rest for 5 minutes, then slice into strips.
Step 7: Assemble Bowl
Divide chickpeas and roasted peppers into bowls, top with sliced chicken.
Step 8: Serve
Drizzle with 1 tsp lemon juice, garnish with 1 tsp chopped cilantro, and serve warm as a nutritious lunch.

instructions: Step 1: Blanch Asparagus
Trim 100g asparagus, boil in salted water for 2–3 minutes, then plunge into ice water and chop into 1-inch pieces.
Step 2: Prepare Salmon
Chop 80g smoked salmon into small pieces and set aside.
Step 3: Whisk Eggs
In a bowl, whisk 4 eggs with ¼ tsp salt and ¼ tsp black pepper until smooth.
Step 4: Heat Pan
Melt 1 tsp butter in a non-stick skillet over medium-low heat, ensuring it coats the pan evenly.
Step 5: Cook Omelette Base
Pour eggs into the skillet, swirling to spread evenly, and cook for 1–2 minutes until edges begin to set.
Step 6: Add Fillings
Sprinkle salmon and asparagus evenly over one half of the omelette, cooking for 1–2 minutes until eggs are mostly set.
Step 7: Fold and Finish
Fold the omelette in half over the fillings, cook for 1 minute, then slide onto a plate.
Step 8: Serve
Garnish with 1 tsp chopped dill, slice if desired, and serve immediately as a light breakfast.

instructions: Step 1: Preheat Oven
Preheat oven to 190°C and line a baking dish with parchment paper.
Step 2: Prepare Eggplants
Halve 2 eggplants lengthwise, scoop out the flesh leaving a ½-inch border, and chop the flesh finely.
Step 3: Cook Lamb
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat, add 300g ground lamb, and cook for 5–6 minutes until browned, breaking it apart.
Step 4: Add Aromatics
Add 50g chopped onion, 1 minced garlic clove, and chopped eggplant flesh to the skillet, sauté for 4–5 minutes until softened.
Step 5: Season Filling
Stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste, ½ tsp cumin, ¼ tsp salt, and ¼ tsp black pepper, cooking for 1 minute to blend flavors.
Step 6: Add Feta
Remove skillet from heat, stir in 80g crumbled feta, and mix well to combine.
Step 7: Stuff and Bake
Spoon lamb-feta mixture into eggplant halves, place in the baking dish, and bake for 35–40 minutes until eggplants are tender.
Step 8: Serve
Garnish with 1 tsp chopped parsley, let rest for 5 minutes, and serve warm as a hearty dinner.

instructions: Step 1: Prepare Tortilla
Lay 1 whole-wheat tortilla flat on a clean surface or cutting board.
Step 2: Spread Hummus
Evenly spread 60g hummus over the entire surface of the tortilla, leaving a small border around the edges.
Step 3: Add Turkey
Arrange 120g turkey slices in a single layer over the hummus, covering most of the tortilla.
Step 4: Add Spinach
Scatter 30g fresh spinach leaves evenly over the turkey slices.
Step 5: Season Lightly
Sprinkle a pinch of black pepper and ¼ tsp dried oregano over the spinach for added flavor.
Step 6: Roll Tortilla
Starting from one edge, tightly roll the tortilla into a log, ensuring the filling stays in place.
Step 7: Slice Pinwheels
Using a sharp knife, slice the rolled tortilla into 1-inch thick pinwheels, yielding about 6–8 pieces.
Step 8: Serve
Arrange pinwheels on a plate, secure with toothpicks if needed, and serve chilled or at room temperature as a quick snack.

instructions: Step 1: Prepare Tomatoes
Slice the tops off 4 medium tomatoes, scoop out the seeds and pulp with a spoon, and set aside to drain upside down.
Step 2: Prepare Tuna
Drain 120g canned tuna and flake it into a mixing bowl.
Step 3: Prepare Avocado
Halve ½ avocado (~70g), remove the pit, scoop out the flesh, and mash it in the bowl with the tuna.
Step 4: Season Mixture
Add 1 tsp lemon juice, ¼ tsp salt, and ¼ tsp black pepper to the tuna-avocado mixture, stirring to combine.
Step 5: Add Herbs
Chop 5g fresh cilantro or parsley and mix into the filling for freshness.
Step 6: Stuff Tomatoes
Spoon the tuna-avocado mixture evenly into the hollowed tomatoes, packing lightly.
Step 7: Chill (Optional)
Refrigerate stuffed tomatoes for 10 minutes to meld flavors, if time allows.
Step 8: Serve
Place stuffed tomatoes on a plate, garnish with a sprinkle of paprika, and serve fresh as a light lunch.

instructions: Step 1: Preheat Oven
Set the oven to 200°C to preheat for roasting and baking.
Step 2: Prepare Eggplant
Slice 1 medium eggplant (about 300g) into 1cm thick rounds and sprinkle with salt to draw out moisture.
Step 3: Roast Eggplant
Pat eggplant dry, brush with 1 tbsp olive oil, and roast on a baking sheet for 15 minutes until tender.
Step 4: Prepare Tomato Sauce
Heat 150g tomato sauce in a small pan, adding salt and pepper to taste if needed.
Step 5: Slice Mozzarella
Thinly slice 100g mozzarella cheese for even layering.
Step 6: Layer Ingredients
In a small baking dish, spread a layer of tomato sauce, add eggplant slices, then top with mozzarella and 5g basil leaves. Repeat layers.
Step 7: Bake Dish
Bake the layered dish at 200°C for 25 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Step 8: Garnish and Serve
Sprinkle with remaining 5g basil, let cool slightly, and serve hot as a dinner meal.

recipeName: Oats & Lentil Dosa with Green Chutney
instructions: Step 1: Soak Ingredients:
Soak 1/2 cup oats and 1/2 cup moong dal in water for 4 hours.
Step 2: Blend Batter:
Drain the soaked oats and dal, then blend them with a pinch of salt and water as needed to form a smooth batter.
Step 3: Prepare Chutney:
Blend 1 cup mint leaves, 1 cup coriander leaves, 1 green chili, 1 tbsp lemon juice, and a pinch of salt into a smooth chutney, adding a little water if required.
Step 4: Heat Pan:
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and lightly grease it with a few drops of oil.
Step 5: Pour Batter:
Pour a ladle of batter onto the hot pan and spread it into a thin, even circle.
Step 6: Cook Dosa:
Cook the dosa for 2 minutes on one side until golden and crispy, then flip and cook for another 2 minutes.
Step 7: Check Consistency:
Ensure the batter is not too thick; add a little water if needed for easier spreading in the next dosa.
Step 8: Serve Hot:
Serve the crispy dosa immediately with a side of the prepared green chutney.

instructions: Step 1: Heat Oil and Spices:
In a pan, heat 1 tsp oil over medium heat, add 1/2 tsp cumin seeds, and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.

instructions: Step 1: Soak and Sprout Moong Dal:

Dust a clean surface with flour, and roll each dough ball into a thin, round flatbread, about 5-6 inches in diameter.

Serve the sprouted moong dal flatbreads hot with yogurt, chutney, or a side of your choice.

recipeName: Chickpea & Barley Idli with Cumin Seeds
instructions: Step 1: Soak Ingredients:
Soak 1/2 cup chickpeas and 1/2 cup barley separately in water overnight or for 8 hours, then drain well.
Step 2: Blend Batter:
Grind the soaked chickpeas and barley with a pinch of cumin seeds, a pinch of salt, and minimal water into a smooth, slightly thick batter.
Step 3: Ferment Batter:
Cover the batter and let it rest in a warm place for 6-8 hours to ferment slightly, until it turns frothy and rises a bit.
Step 4: Prepare Steamer:
Fill a steamer or idli pot with water, bring it to a boil, and lightly grease the idli molds with oil.
Step 5: Pour Batter:
Stir the fermented batter gently, then pour it into the greased idli molds, filling each mold about three-quarters full.
Step 6: Steam Idlis:
Place the molds in the steamer, cover, and steam for 10-15 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the idlis comes out clean.
Step 7: Cool and Remove:
Let the idlis cool for 2-3 minutes, then carefully remove them from the molds using a spoon.
Step 8: Serve Hot:
Serve the soft chickpea-barley idlis hot with coconut chutney or a side of sambar for a wholesome meal.

instructions: Step 1: Prepare the ingredients:
Wash 1 cup brown rice and 1/2 cup urad dal (split black gram) separately. Soak them in water for 4-6 hours, then drain and set aside.
Step 2: Grind the batter:
Grind urad dal with 1/4 cup water into a smooth, fluffy paste. Grind brown rice with 1/4 cup water into a slightly coarse paste. Mix both in a large bowl.
Step 3: Add seasonings:
Add a pinch of fenugreek powder and salt to taste. Mix well to form a smooth batter.
Step 4: Ferment the batter:
Cover the bowl and leave it in a warm place for 8-10 hours or overnight. The batter should rise and turn slightly frothy.
Step 5: Prepare for steaming:
Gently stir the fermented batter. Optionally, add a pinch of baking soda and mix. Grease idli molds with oil.
Step 6: Steam the idlis:
Pour batter into the molds, filling each 3/4 full. Steam for 10-12 minutes on medium heat. Let cool for 5 minutes before removing.
Step 7: Prepare the chutney (optional):
Blend 1/2 cup coriander, 1/4 cup mint, 1 green chili, 1/2 inch ginger, and a pinch of salt into a smooth paste. Add lemon juice.
Step 8: Serve:
Serve the hot idlis with coriander-mint chutney or a portion of sambar.

instructions: Step 1: Prepare the marinade:

In a mixing bowl, combine 150g Greek yogurt, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste, 1/2 tsp turmeric powder, 1 tsp cumin powder, 1 tsp coriander powder, 1 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp paprika, 1/2 tsp red chili powder, and salt to taste. Mix thoroughly to form a smooth marinade.
Step 2: Prep the chicken:
Take 200g of skinless chicken breast and make small shallow cuts on the surface to help the marinade penetrate better.
Step 3: Marinate the chicken:
Coat the chicken evenly with the prepared marinade. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 2-3 hours or overnight for best flavor.
Step 4: Preheat the grill:
Preheat your grill to medium-high heat (around 375–400°F). Lightly brush the grill grates with 1/2 tsp olive oil to prevent the chicken from sticking.
Step 5: Grill the first side:
Place the marinated chicken on the preheated grill and cook for about 6-8 minutes on one side without moving it too much.
Step 6: Flip and finish grilling:
Flip the chicken and cook the other side for another 6-8 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 165°F and grill marks form.
Step 7: Rest the chicken:
Remove the chicken from the grill and let it rest for 5 minutes. This allows the juices to redistribute and keeps the chicken moist.
Step 8: Serve:
Serve the grilled chicken hot with a side of mint chutney and a fresh salad for a complete, flavorful meal.

Carefully remove the chicken from the slow cooker and set it aside. Strain the broth to remove any solids, leaving a clear, flavorful liquid.

Once the chicken has cooled slightly, shred the meat using two forks, discarding any bones or skin.

Return the shredded chicken to the strained broth, mixing it well to combine the flavors.

If not serving immediately, allow the soup to cool, then store it in an airtight container in the fridge for up to a few days, or freeze for later use.

recipeName: Split Green Pea Soup with Ginger & Garlic
instructions: Step 1: Prepare the Split Peas :
Wash 1 cup split green peas (hara matar dal) thoroughly and drain.
In a large pot, add the split peas with 4 cups of water and a pinch of salt.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30-35 minutes until the peas are soft and partially broken down.
Skim off any foam that rises to the surface during cooking.
Step 2: Prepare the Aromatics :
In a separate pan, heat 1 tsp oil and add 1 tsp cumin seeds.
When they start to splutter, add 1 bay leaf and 1 small cinnamon stick.
Add 1/2 cup finely chopped onions and sauté until golden brown.
Add 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste and cook for 1-2 minutes until the raw smell disappears.
Step 3: Add Vegetables :
Add 1/4 cup finely chopped carrots and 1/4 cup finely chopped celery.
Sauté for 3-4 minutes until the vegetables start to soften.
Add 1/2 cup chopped tomatoes and cook until they break down and become mushy.
Step 4: Add Spices :
Add 1/2 tsp turmeric powder, 1/2 tsp coriander powder, 1/4 tsp black pepper, and a pinch of red chili powder.
Sauté for 1-2 minutes until the spices are well combined and aromatic.
Step 5: Combine and Simmer :
Add the spiced vegetable mixture to the cooked split peas.
Add 1 cup vegetable broth or water if a thinner consistency is desired.
Simmer for 10-15 minutes on low heat, stirring occasionally.
Using the back of a spoon, mash some of the peas against the side of the pot to thicken the soup.
Step 6: Add Freshness :
Stir in 1 tbsp lemon juice and 2 tbsp finely chopped coriander leaves.
Adjust salt and spices according to taste.
Step 7: Garnish :
Garnish with a few more chopped coriander leaves and a lemon wedge.
Step 8: Serve :
Serve hot with a slice of whole grain bread if desired.

recipeName: Barley Roti with Cucumber Yogurt Dip

ingredients.quantity: 1 tsp (5g, optional, assumed used for brushing)
To taste (assumed 1 tsp, 3g, split between dough and raita)

instructions: Step 1: Prepare the Barley Roti Dough :
In a large bowl, mix 2 cups barley flour with 1/2 cup whole wheat flour and a pinch of salt.
Gradually add warm water (approximately 1 cup) and knead to form a soft, pliable dough.
If the dough feels too dry, add a little more water; if too sticky, add a sprinkle of barley flour.
Cover with a damp cloth and let it rest for 20-30 minutes.
Step 2: Prepare the Cucumber Yogurt Dip :
Grate 1 medium cucumber and squeeze out excess water.
In a bowl, whisk 1 cup low-fats yogurt until smooth.
Add the grated cucumber, 1/4 tsp roasted cumin powder, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 finely chopped green chili, 2 tbsp chopped mint leaves, and salt to taste.
Mix well and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Step 3: Make the Rotis :
Divide the dough into 8 equal portions and form smooth balls.
Take one ball at a time, flatten it slightly, and dust with barley flour.
Roll it into a circular shape of about 6-7 inches in diameter using a rolling pin.
Heat a tawa (flat pan) on medium heat.
Step 4: Cook the Rotis :
Place the rolled roti on the hot tawa.
When small bubbles appear (about 30 seconds), flip and cook the other side.
Flip again and press gently with a cloth to help it puff up.
Cook until both sides have light brown spots.
Remove from heat and place on a serving plate.
Step 5: Finish the Rotis :
Lightly brush each roti with 1/4 tsp ghee if desired (optional for authentic taste).
Cover with a clean cloth to keep warm while making the remaining rotis.

In a pan, heat 1 tsp oil and add 1/2 tsp cumin seeds and 1/2 tsp mustard seeds.

Divide the dough into 8 equal portions and form smooth balls.
Roll each ball into a circular shape of about 6-7 inches in diameter using a rolling pin and dry flour as needed.

Add a squeeze of lemon juice for a refreshing zing.

Serve with steamed rice or whole wheat roti for a wholesome meal.

Store any leftover broth in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days.

recipeName: Whole Green Gram Dal (Sabut Moong Dal Tadka)
instructions: Step 1: Soak and Cook the Dal :

Wash 1 cup whole green gram (sabut moong dal) and soak it in water for 2-3 hours. Drain, rinse again, and add it to a pressure cooker with 3 cups water, 1/2 tsp turmeric powder, and a pinch of salt. Pressure cook for 2-3 whistles, then cook on low heat for 5 minutes. Let the pressure release naturally.
Step 2: Sauté Onions and Tomatoes :

In a separate pan, heat 1 tsp oil and add 1/2 cup finely chopped onions. Sauté until golden brown, then add 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste and cook for a minute. Add 1/2 cup finely chopped tomatoes and cook until soft and mushy.
Step 3: Add Vegetables :
Add 1/4 cup finely chopped carrots and 1/4 cup finely chopped bell peppers. Sauté the vegetables for 3-4 minutes until they begin to soften.
Step 4: Add Spices :
Add 1/2 tsp coriander powder, 1/4 tsp cumin powder, 1/4 tsp red chili powder, and a pinch of asafoetida. Mix and sauté for 1-2 minutes until the spices are aromatic.
Step 5: Combine Dal and Vegetables :
Add the cooked dal to the spiced vegetable mixture and stir to combine. Simmer on low heat for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally. Adjust consistency by adding hot water if needed.
Step 6: Prepare the Tadka :
In a small pan, heat 1/2 tsp ghee and add 1/2 tsp cumin seeds. When they splutter, add 1 dried red chili, 1 chopped green chili, and a few curry leaves. Sauté for 30 seconds until aromatic.
Step 7: Add Tadka to Dal :
Pour the prepared tadka over the simmering dal and stir gently to mix the flavors.
Step 8: Serve the Dal :
Garnish with freshly chopped coriander and a squeeze of lemon juice. Serve hot with a small portion of brown rice or millet roti.

recipeName: Grilled Boneless Chicken Breast (Spiced, No Oil)
instructions: Step 1: Prepare the marinade :

In a bowl, mix 500g boneless chicken breast with 1 tsp cumin powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1/2 tsp turmeric powder, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp lemon juice, salt to taste, and 1/2 tsp black pepper. Marinate for 30 minutes to allow the flavors to absorb.
Step 2: Preheat the grill :
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat to ensure even cooking and nice grill marks on the chicken.
Step 3: Prepare the grill surface :
Lightly oil the grill grates or brush a small amount of olive oil on the chicken to prevent sticking during grilling.
Step 4: Place the chicken on the grill :
Carefully place the marinated chicken breasts on the hot grill and avoid moving them too much to get a good sear.
Step 5: Grill the first side :
Cook the chicken for about 6-7 minutes on the first side without flipping to develop a nice crust and grill lines.
Step 6: Flip and grill the other side :
Turn the chicken and cook the other side for another 6-7 minutes or until the internal temperature reaches 75°C (165°F).
Step 7: Rest the chicken :
Remove the grilled chicken from the heat and let it rest for 5 minutes to retain its juices and tenderness.
Step 8: Serve :
Slice and serve the grilled boneless chicken breast hot with a side of steamed vegetables or a fresh salad.

instructions: Step 1: Prepare the Black Chickpeas:

Wash 1 cup black chickpeas (kala chana) thoroughly and soak in water overnight or for at least 8 hours. Drain the water and rinse the chickpeas. In a pressure cooker, add the soaked chickpeas with 3 cups of water and a pinch of salt. Pressure cook for 3-4 whistles, then lower the heat and cook for another 5 minutes. Let the pressure release naturally, then drain and reserve 1 cup of the cooking liquid.
Step 2: Prepare the Spinach:

Wash 2 cups spinach leaves thoroughly. Blanch the spinach in boiling water for 1 minute, then immediately transfer to ice water to stop the cooking process. Drain and blend to a smooth paste. Set aside.
Step 3: Prepare the Curry Base:

In a pan, heat 1 tsp oil and add 1/2 tsp cumin seeds. When they start to splutter, add 1 bay leaf and 2 cloves. Add 1 finely chopped onion and sauté until golden brown. Add 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste and cook for a minute until the raw smell disappears.
Step 4: Add Tomatoes and Spices:

Add 1 finely chopped tomato and cook until it softens and becomes mushy. Add 1/2 tsp turmeric powder, 1 tsp coriander powder, 1/2 tsp cumin powder, 1/4 tsp red chili powder, and 1/4 tsp garam masala. Sauté for 2-3 minutes until the spices are well combined and aromatic.
Step 5: Combine and Simmer:

Add the cooked black chickpeas to the spice mixture and stir well. Add the reserved cooking liquid and simmer for 5 minutes. Add the spinach puree and mix well. Simmer for another 10 minutes on low heat, stirring occasionally. If the curry becomes too thick, add a little water to achieve desired consistency.
Step 6: Serve:
Garnish with freshly chopped coriander leaves. Serve hot with a small portion of brown rice or whole wheat roti.

instructions: Step 1: Marinate the Quail:

Take 4 quail birds and marinate them with 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste, 1 tbsp yogurt, 1 tsp garam masala, 1/2 tsp turmeric powder, 1 tsp red chili powder, 1/2 tsp cumin powder, 1 tbsp lemon juice, and salt to taste. Let it marinate for at least 2 hours.

Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Step 3: Prepare for Grilling:
Place the marinated quail on the grill and ensure the grill is clean and oiled to prevent sticking.
Step 4: Grill the Quail (First Side):
Grill the quail for 5-7 minutes on the first side, allowing it to cook through and develop a slight char.
Step 5: Flip and Grill the Quail (Second Side):
Flip the quail over and grill for another 5-7 minutes until the meat is cooked thoroughly and slightly charred.
Step 6: Check for Doneness:
Ensure the quail is fully cooked by checking that the internal temperature reaches 165°F (75°C) or the juices run clear.
Step 7: Remove from the Grill:
Take the grilled quail off the grill and let it rest for a few minutes to retain its juices.
Step 8: Serve:
Garnish with fresh coriander and serve with a side of raita or salad.

instructions: Step 1: Prepare the Soya Granules:
Soak 1 cup soya granules in warm water for 10 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Step 2: Heat the Oil:
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan over medium heat.
Step 3: Sauté the Onions and Ginger-Garlic Paste:
Add 1 chopped onion and 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste to the pan. Sauté until the onion turns golden brown.
Step 4: Add the Tomato:
Add 1 chopped tomato to the pan and cook until it softens and blends into the mixture.
Step 5: Add the Spices:
Add 1 tsp red chili powder, 1/2 tsp turmeric powder, 1/2 tsp cumin powder, and salt. Stir well to combine.
Step 6: Add the Soya Granules:
Add the soaked and drained soya granules to the pan. Stir thoroughly to coat them with the spices and tomato mixture.
Step 7: Cook the Mixture:
Cook the soya granules mixture on low heat for 10-12 minutes, stirring occasionally to ensure even cooking.
Step 8: Garnish and Serve:
Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and serve hot with roti or rice.

recipeName: Haleem (Lean Meat Version, No Extra Ghee)
instructions: Step 1: Cook the Meat:
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large pot. Add 500g lean meat (chicken or beef), 1 chopped onion, and 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste. Cook until browned.
Step 2: Add Spices and Grains:
Add 1 tsp red chili powder, 1/2 tsp turmeric powder, 1 tsp cumin powder, and salt. Then, add 1/2 cup wheat (soaked overnight) and 1/2 cup split yellow lentils. Stir well.
Step 3: Cook the Mixture:
Add 4 cups water and cook the mixture on low heat for 1-1.5 hours, stirring occasionally.
Step 4: Blend the Mixture:
Use an immersion blender to blend the cooked mixture until smooth.
Step 5: Garnish with Fried Onions:
Top the blended mixture with fried onions for added texture and flavor.
Step 6: Add Fresh Coriander:
Sprinkle fresh coriander leaves on top for a burst of freshness.
Step 7: Add Lemon:
Squeeze a little lemon juice over the dish to enhance the flavors.
Step 8: Serve Hot:
Serve the dish hot with a side of naan or rice for a complete meal.

recipeName: Homemade Protein Lassi (Greek Yogurt, No Sugar)
instructions: Step 1: Blend the Ingredients:
In a blender, add 1 cup Greek yogurt (یونانی دہی), 1 cup water (پانی), 1/2 tsp cardamom powder (الائچی پاؤڈر), and a pinch of salt (نمک). Blend until smooth.
Step 2: Check Consistency:
If the lassi is too thick, add a little more water to adjust the consistency.
Step 3: Taste and Adjust:
Taste the lassi and add more cardamom powder or salt if needed, then blend again.
Step 4: Chill (Optional):
For a colder drink, refrigerate the lassi for 10-15 minutes before serving.
Step 5: Garnish (Optional):
Garnish with a pinch of cardamom powder on top for extra flavor and presentation.
Step 6: Pour into Glasses:
Pour the blended lassi into a glass, filling each glass about three-quarters full.
Step 7: Serve Immediately:
Serve the lassi immediately while it's cold and refreshing.
Step 8: Enjoy:
Enjoy your refreshing lassi on a hot day or as a light, healthy drink.

recipeName: Cottage Cheese Bhurji (Scrambled Paneer, No Butter)
instructions: Step 1: Prepare the Ingredients:
Grate 1 cup of cottage cheese (paneer) and set it aside. Chop 1 onion, 1 tomato, and 1 green chili.
Step 2: Sauté the Vegetables:
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan. Add chopped onion and sauté until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste (1 tsp), followed by chopped tomatoes and green chili. Cook until tomatoes soften.

Add the grated paneer to the pan, along with 1/2 tsp cumin powder, 1/2 tsp turmeric powder, 1 tsp red chili powder, and salt to taste. Stir well and cook for 5-7 minutes until the paneer absorbs the spices.
Step 4: Adjust the Consistency:
If needed, add a splash of water or milk to achieve the desired consistency for the scramble.
Step 5: Taste and Adjust Seasoning:
Taste the scrambled paneer and adjust the seasoning with more salt or spices if required.
Step 6: Garnish:
Garnish the scrambled paneer with fresh coriander leaves.
Step 7: Serve Hot:
Serve the scrambled paneer hot, ideal with roti, paratha, or rice.
Step 8: Enjoy:
Enjoy your flavorful scrambled paneer with a side of chutney or yogurt.

instructions: Step 1: Prepare the Marinade:
In a bowl, combine 1 cup yogurt, 1 tsp red chili powder, 1 tsp turmeric powder, 1 tsp cumin powder, 1 tsp garam masala, and salt. Mix well.
Step 2: Marinate the Turkey:
Coat 500g turkey breast with the marinade. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour or overnight for deeper flavor.
Step 3: Preheat the Oven:
Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F) to ensure it reaches the correct temperature before cooking.
Step 4: Prepare the Baking Tray:
Place a sheet of parchment paper on a baking tray or lightly grease it with oil to prevent sticking.
Step 5: Bake the Turkey:
Place the marinated turkey breast on the prepared baking tray. Bake for 25-30 minutes, turning once halfway through, until fully cooked.
Step 6: Check for Doneness:
Ensure the internal temperature of the turkey reaches 75°C (165°F) for safe consumption.
Step 7: Garnish and Rest:
Remove the turkey from the oven and let it rest for 5-10 minutes before serving to retain its juices.
Step 8: Serve:
Serve hot with a squeeze of lemon and a side of your favorite vegetables or salad.

instructions: Step 1: Boil the Lobia:
Rinse 1 cup lobia (black-eyed peas) and boil them in water for 10-12 minutes until tender. Drain and set aside.
Step 2: Prepare the Salad:
In a large bowl, combine the boiled lobia, 1 chopped tomato, 1 chopped cucumber, 1 finely chopped green chili, and 1 tbsp lemon juice. Add salt to taste.
Step 3: Add Seasonings:
Season the salad with a pinch of black pepper and mix well for an even distribution of flavors.
Step 4: Mix the Ingredients:
Toss all the ingredients gently to combine them, ensuring that the lemon juice and seasonings coat everything evenly.
Step 5: Garnish with Fresh Herbs:
Garnish the salad with freshly chopped coriander leaves for added flavor and color.
Step 6: Chill the Salad:
Refrigerate the salad for 10-15 minutes if you prefer it cold before serving.
Step 7: Taste and Adjust:
Before serving, taste the salad and adjust salt or lemon juice if necessary.
Step 8: Serve:
Serve the salad immediately as a refreshing side dish or light meal.

Add a splash of water if the mixture is too thick, and stir well to incorporate the flavors.

Let the chicken cook in the tomato-based gravy for another 10-15 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld together.
Step 7: Check for Doneness:
Ensure the chicken is cooked through and the gravy has thickened to your desired consistency.
Step 8: Serve:
Garnish with fresh coriander and serve with rice or naan.

instructions: Step 1: Cook the Chicken:

In a pan, heat 1 tbsp oil and sauté 1 chopped onion until golden brown. Add 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste and cook for another 1-2 minutes. Add 500g chicken pieces and cook until the chicken turns white and starts releasing juices.

Add 1 tsp cumin powder, 1/2 tsp turmeric powder, 1/2 tsp red chili powder, and salt to taste. Stir well and let the chicken cook for 5-7 minutes.
Step 3: Add the Okra (Bhindi):
Add 2 cups of sliced okra (bhindi) and mix well.
Step 4: Cover and Cook:
Cover and cook on low heat for 15-20 minutes until the okra is tender and the chicken is fully cooked.
Step 5: Check the Consistency:
Stir occasionally and check if the okra is cooked and the chicken has absorbed the spices.
Step 6: Adjust the Seasoning:
Taste and adjust the salt or spice levels if needed.

Garnish with fresh coriander to enhance the flavor.
Step 8: Serve:
Serve hot with chapati or rice.

recipeName: Spicy Egg Masala (Cooked in Tomato Puree)
instructions: Step 1: Prepare the Eggs:
Hard-boil 4 eggs, peel them, and set them aside.
Step 2: Make the Masala Base:
In a pan, heat 2 tbsp oil. Add 1 chopped onion and sauté until golden brown. Add 2 chopped tomatoes, 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste, 1 tsp cumin seeds, and sauté until the tomatoes soften.
Step 3: Add Spices:
Stir in 1 tsp red chili powder, 1/2 tsp turmeric powder, 1/2 tsp garam masala, 1/2 tsp coriander powder, and salt to taste. Cook for 2-3 minutes, allowing the oil to separate from the masala.
Step 4: Cook the Eggs in the Masala:
Gently add the boiled eggs to the masala and stir gently to coat them with the sauce. Add 1/4 cup water to make a gravy and cook for 5 minutes.
Step 5: Garnish and Serve:
Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and serve hot with roti or rice.
Step 6: Optional Heat Adjustment:
If you prefer a spicier dish, adjust the red chili powder to taste or add green chilies to the masala.
Step 7: Simmer for Full Flavor:
Let the eggs simmer in the masala for an additional 5 minutes for enhanced flavor absorption.
Step 8: Enjoy:
Enjoy your egg curry hot, perfect with a side of warm naan or steamed rice.

recipeName: Quinoa Chicken Pilaf (High Protein Alternative to Rice)
instructions: Step 1: Cook the Quinoa:
Rinse 1 cup quinoa thoroughly and cook it in 2 cups of water or chicken broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and cover for 15 minutes until the quinoa is cooked and fluffy.
Step 2: Prepare the Chicken:
In a pan, heat 2 tbsp oil and sauté 500g chicken breast (diced) with salt, pepper, and 1 tsp cumin powder until browned and cooked through.
Step 3: Make the Pilaf:

In the same pan, add 1 chopped onion and 2 chopped tomatoes. Sauté until softened. Add 1/2 tsp turmeric powder, 1 tsp coriander powder, and 1/2 tsp red chili powder. Stir in the cooked quinoa and chicken, and mix well.
Step 4: Garnish and Serve:
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve with a side of yogurt or a salad.
Step 5: Adjust Flavor:
Taste the pilaf and adjust the seasoning if necessary, adding more salt, pepper, or spices to suit your taste.
Step 6: Add More Veggies (Optional):
For extra nutrition, consider adding some sautéed vegetables such as bell peppers or spinach to the pilaf.
Step 7: Let it Rest:
Allow the pilaf to rest for a couple of minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
Step 8: Enjoy:
Serve your quinoa and chicken pilaf hot, enjoying the flavorful combination with a cooling yogurt side or a refreshing salad.

Line a baking tray with parchment paper or lightly grease it to prevent sticking. Arrange the meatballs on the tray with space between each one.

Place the tray in the preheated oven and bake for 20–25 minutes, or until the meatballs are golden brown and fully cooked through.

Remove the meatballs from the oven and let them cool slightly. Serve warm with a dipping sauce or pair with a fresh salad for a light lunch.

recipeName: Smoked Lentils (Coal Infused Flavor, No Butter)

ingredients.quantity: 1 cup (200g, assumed yellow moong dal, dry)

instructions: Step 1: Cook Lentils:
Rinse 1 cup of lentils and cook them in 2 cups of water with 1/2 tsp turmeric powder and salt to taste. Simmer until soft, around 20 minutes.
Step 2: Prepare the Tempering:
In a pan, heat 1 tbsp oil, add 1 tsp cumin seeds, and fry until they splutter. Add chopped onions and sauté until golden.
Step 3: Add Spices:
Stir in 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste, 1/2 tsp red chili powder, 1 tsp coriander powder, and 1 tsp garam masala. Cook for 2-3 minutes.
Step 4: Smoke the Lentils:
Pour the tempering over the cooked lentils and let them simmer for 5 minutes. Add a piece of burning coal to a small bowl, place it in the pan, and cover to infuse the smoky flavor.
Step 5: Serve:
Remove the coal and serve hot.
Step 6: Adjust Consistency:
If the lentils are too thick, add a little water and simmer for a few more minutes to reach your desired consistency.
Step 7: Garnish:
Garnish with fresh cilantro and a squeeze of lemon juice for added freshness.
Step 8: Enjoy:
Serve the smoky dal with steamed rice or flatbread (roti) for a complete and flavorful meal.

instructions: Step 1: Soak the Lentils:
Rinse and soak split urad dal (lentils) in water for 4–6 hours or overnight until they soften.
Step 2: Prepare the Batter:
Drain the soaked dal and grind it into a smooth, thick batter using minimal water. Add salt and optional spices like cumin or ginger.
Step 3: Preheat the Oven:
Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and lightly grease a baking tray or use a silicone mold for uniform shapes.
Step 4: Shape the Dumplings:
Scoop spoonfuls of batter and shape into small dumplings, placing them on the prepared tray.
Step 5: Bake the Dumplings:
Bake the dumplings for 20–25 minutes or until they turn golden brown and are cooked through.
Step 6: Soak in Warm Water:
After baking, soak the dumplings in warm water for 10–15 minutes to soften them.
Step 7: Prepare the Yogurt Base:
Whisk low-fats yogurt until smooth. Add a pinch of salt, roasted cumin powder, and a dash of red chili powder.
Step 8: Assemble and Serve:
Gently squeeze water from the dumplings, place them in a serving dish, pour yogurt over them, sprinkle spices, and serve chilled or at room temperature.

recipeName: Kala Chana Chaat (Black Chickpea Salad with Lemon)
instructions: Step 1: Prepare the Black Chickpeas:

Wash 1 cup black chickpeas (kala chana) thoroughly and soak in water overnight or for at least 8 hours. Drain the water and rinse the chickpeas. In a pressure cooker, add the soaked chickpeas with 3 cups of water and a pinch of salt. Pressure cook for 2-3 whistles, then lower the heat and cook for another 5 minutes. The chickpeas should be cooked but firm, not mushy. Let the pressure release naturally, then drain and cool completely.
Step 2: Prepare the Vegetables:
Finely chop 1/2 cup onions, 1/2 cup tomatoes, 1/4 cup cucumber, and 1 green chili. Finely chop 2 tbsp fresh coriander and 1 tbsp mint leaves.
Step 3: Prepare the Dressing:

In a small bowl, mix 2 tbsp lemon juice, 1/2 tsp roasted cumin powder, 1/2 tsp black salt (kala namak), 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/2 tsp chaat masala, and 1/4 tsp red chili powder. Whisk well to combine all the ingredients.
Step 4: Assemble the Chaat:

In a large bowl, add the cooked and cooled black chickpeas. Add all the chopped vegetables, coriander, and mint leaves. Pour the dressing over the chickpeas and vegetables. Mix gently to ensure everything is well combined.
Step 5: Enhance the Flavors (Optional):
For added flavor, you can add 1/4 cup grated radish and 1 tbsp pomegranate seeds if in season.
Step 6: Serve:
Let the chaat sit for 5-10 minutes to allow the flavors to meld. Serve at room temperature for a refreshing, protein-rich snack or light meal.
Step 7: Adjust the Spice Level:
If you prefer more heat, add extra green chilies or red chili powder to your taste.
Step 8: Enjoy:
Serve immediately or store in the refrigerator for up to 1 day. Enjoy the fresh, flavorful black chickpea chaat!

recipeName: Brown Rice Dhokla (Steamed Lentil Cake with Curd)

ingredients.quantity: To taste (assumed 1 tsp, 3g, split between batter and dip)
As needed (assumed 1/2 cup, 120ml, for batter consistency)

instructions: Step 1: Prepare the Batter:
Mix 1 cup brown rice flour, 1/2 cup besan (gram flour), and 1/2 cup yogurt in a bowl.
Add 1 cup water gradually to form a smooth batter of pouring consistency.
Add 1/2 tsp ginger paste, 1 green chili (finely chopped), and a pinch of salt.
Mix well and let the batter ferment for 2-3 hours.
Step 2: Prepare the Dhokla:
After fermentation, add 1/2 tsp fruit salt (eno) to the batter and mix gently.
Immediately pour the batter into a greased dhokla plate or steaming container.
Steam for 15-20 minutes or until a toothpick inserted comes out clean.
Let it cool for 5 minutes, then cut into square pieces.
Step 3: Prepare the Tempering:
In a small pan, heat 1/2 tsp oil and add 1/2 tsp mustard seeds.
When they start to splutter, add 1/2 tsp cumin seeds, 1 chopped green chili, and a few curry leaves.
Sauté for 30 seconds until aromatic.
Add 2 tbsp water and 1/2 tsp lemon juice to create a light sauce.
Step 4: Finalize the Dhokla:
Pour the tempering evenly over the cut dhokla pieces.
Garnish with freshly chopped coriander leaves.
Step 5: Prepare the Curd Accompaniment:
Whisk 1/2 cup low-fats yogurt until smooth.
Add 1/4 tsp roasted cumin powder, a pinch of salt, and chopped coriander leaves.
Mix well and keep aside.
Step 6: Serve:
Serve the dhokla with the prepared curd accompaniment and mint-coriander chutney if desired.

Step 3: Temper the Cumin Seeds: Add 1 tsp cumin seeds and let them splutter for 20-30 seconds, stirring gently.
Step 4: Sauté the Aromatics: Add 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste and sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Step 5: Brown the Mutton: Add 500g mutton pieces and fry for 5-7 minutes on medium-high heat until lightly browned.
Step 6: Add Tomatoes and Spices: Stir in 2 chopped tomatoes, 2-3 green chilies, 1 tsp red chili powder, and 1 tsp salt. Cook for 10 minutes until tomatoes soften.
Step 7: Simmer with Yogurt: Add ½ cup yogurt, reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 40-45 minutes until mutton is tender, adding a splash of water if needed.
Step 8: Finish and Serve: Sprinkle ½ tsp garam masala, garnish with coriander, and serve hot with whole wheat roti.

instructions: Step 1: Prepare the Ingredients: Gather 500g beef, 4 tbsp oil, 2 sliced onions, 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste, 2 chopped tomatoes, 2-3 green chilies, 2 tbsp biryani masala, 1 tsp salt, ½ cup yogurt, 2 cups basmati rice, whole spices (1 cinnamon stick, 2 cloves, 2 cardamom pods), and chopped coriander and mint for garnish.
Step 2: Fry the Onions: Heat 4 tbsp oil in a large pot over medium heat and fry 2 sliced onions until golden brown, about 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Step 3: Cook the Beef Base: Add 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste and 500g beef pieces to the pot, frying for 5-7 minutes until the beef is lightly browned and aromatic.
Step 4: Add Spices and Tomatoes: Stir in 2 chopped tomatoes, 2-3 green chilies, 2 tbsp biryani masala, and 1 tsp salt, cooking for 10 minutes until the tomatoes soften into a thick masala.
Step 5: Simmer with Yogurt: Mix in ½ cup yogurt, reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 40 minutes until the beef is tender, adding a little water if it gets too dry.

Step 6: Boil the Rice: In a separate pot, bring 6 cups of water to a boil with 1 cinnamon stick, 2 cloves, and 2 cardamom pods. Add 2 cups basmati rice and cook until 80% done, about 6-8 minutes, then drain.

Step 7: Layer and Steam: In the beef pot, layer the partially cooked rice over the beef curry. Sprinkle chopped coriander and mint on top, cover tightly, and steam on low heat for 10 minutes to blend the flavors.
Step 8: Serve with Raita: Fluff the biryani gently, then serve hot with a side of yogurt raita made by mixing 1 cup yogurt with a pinch of salt, cumin, and chopped cucumber.

instructions: Step 1: Gather the Ingredients: Collect 500g boneless chicken, ½ cup yogurt, ¼ cup cream, 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste, 2 chopped green chilies, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tsp salt, ½ tsp white pepper, 2 tbsp butter, and tandoori roti for serving.

Step 2: Prepare the Marinade: In a large bowl, combine ½ cup yogurt, ¼ cup cream, 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste, 2 chopped green chilies, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tsp salt, and ½ tsp white pepper, mixing until smooth.
Step 3: Marinate the Chicken: Add 500g boneless chicken pieces to the marinade, coating them well, then cover and refrigerate for 2-3 hours to let the flavors soak in.
Step 4: Preheat the Grill: Heat your grill (or a grill pan) to medium-high, about 10 minutes before cooking, ensuring it’s ready for even grilling.
Step 5: Prepare the Grill Surface: Brush the grill grates or pan with 2 tbsp melted butter to prevent sticking and add a rich flavor to the tikka.
Step 6: Grill the Chicken: Place the marinated chicken pieces on the grill and cook for 15 minutes, turning occasionally, until charred and fully cooked through.
Step 7: Check for Doneness: Ensure the chicken is juicy and tender with a golden exterior; cut into a piece to confirm it’s no longer pink inside.
Step 8: Serve with Tandoori Roti: Remove the chicken from the grill, plate it hot, and serve alongside warm tandoori roti for a creamy, smoky meal.

instructions: Step 1: Gather the Ingredients: Collect 3 tbsp ghee (1 for keema, 2 for cooking), 1 chopped onion, 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste, 250g minced beef, 1 tsp red chili powder, 1 tsp salt, 2 cups whole wheat flour, water for dough, butter, and yogurt for serving.

Step 4: Cook the Keema: Stir in 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste, 300g minced beef, 1 tsp red chili powder, and 1 tsp salt, cooking for 10-12 minutes until the keema is fully cooked and dry.
Step 5: Prepare the Dough: In a bowl, knead 2 cups whole wheat flour with water into a soft dough, then divide into 4-6 equal balls.

Step 8: Serve with Butter and Yogurt: Plate the hot keema parathas, top with a dollop of butter, and serve with a side of plain yogurt.

instructions: Step 1: Gather the Ingredients: Collect 2 tbsp butter, 4 pre-made shami kababs, 2 eggs (beaten), 4 parathas, 1 sliced onion, 1 sliced tomato, 2 tbsp green chutney, and salt to taste.
Step 2: Heat the Butter: Melt 2 tbsp butter in a frying pan over medium heat for 1-2 minutes until it’s hot and sizzling.
Step 3: Cook the Shami Kababs: Place 4 shami kababs in the pan and cook for 3-4 minutes per side until crispy and golden brown, then set aside.
Step 4: Prepare the Omelet: In the same pan, pour 2 beaten eggs with a pinch of salt, cooking for 2-3 minutes until set into a thin omelet, then remove from heat.
Step 5: Warm the Paratha: Heat a paratha on a dry tawa or pan for 1-2 minutes per side until soft and lightly toasted.
Step 6: Assemble the Base: Lay the warm paratha flat, place the omelet on top, and spread ½ tbsp green chutney over the omelet.
Step 7: Add Fillings: Arrange 1-2 shami kababs on the omelet, then top with a few slices of onion and tomato for crunch and flavor.
Step 8: Roll and Serve: Fold the paratha tightly around the fillings to form a roll, then serve hot for a delicious, hearty meal.

instructions: Step 1: Gather the Ingredients: Collect 1 whole pomfret fish (cleaned), ½ cup yogurt, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tsp garlic paste, 1 tsp red chili powder, 1 tsp salt, 2 tbsp oil, 3 tbsp butter, 1 tbsp extra lemon juice for sauce, and fresh coriander for garnish.

Step 3: Marinate the Pomfret: Slash  pomfret fish on both sides, coat them with the marinade, ensuring it gets into the cuts, and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Step 4: Preheat the Grill: Heat a grill or grill pan over medium-high heat for 5-7 minutes until ready for cooking.
Step 5: Grill the Fish: Brush the grill with 2 tbsp oil, place the marinated pomfret on it, and cook for 5-7 minutes per side until charred and cooked through.

Step 7: Check the Fish: Ensure the pomfret is flaky and fully cooked by testing with a fork; remove from the grill when done.
Step 8: Serve with Sauce: Plate the hot tandoori pomfret, drizzle with lemon butter sauce, garnish with coriander, and serve immediately.

recipeName: Chana Dal Gosht with Butter Naan
instructions: Step 1: Gather the Ingredients: Collect 3 tbsp oil, 1 sliced onion, 1 tsp garlic paste, 2 chopped tomatoes, 1 tsp red chili powder, 1 tsp salt, 200g mutton (cut into pieces), 1 cup chana dal (soaked for 2 hours), 4 cups water, and butter naan for serving.
Step 2: Heat the Oil: Pour 3 tbsp oil into a deep pan and heat over medium heat for 1-2 minutes until warm.
Step 3: Sauté the Onions: Add 1 sliced onion and sauté for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until golden brown.
Step 4: Cook the Base: Stir in 1 tsp garlic paste, 2 chopped tomatoes, 1 tsp red chili powder, and 1 tsp salt, cooking for 5 minutes until the tomatoes soften into a thick mixture.
Step 5: Add Mutton and Chana Dal: Mix in 200g mutton pieces and 1 cup soaked chana dal, stirring to coat them with the spices.
Step 6: Simmer the Dish: Pour in 4 cups water, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1.5-2 hours until the mutton and dal are tender.
Step 7: Check the Consistency: Ensure the mutton is soft and the chana dal is cooked but not mushy; adjust with a little more water if needed, then cook uncovered for 5 minutes to thicken the gravy.
Step 8: Serve with Butter Naan: Plate the hot chana dal gosht and serve with warm butter naan brushed with melted butter for a rich meal.

recipeName: Coconut Chicken Curry with Zeera Rice
instructions: Step 1: Gather Ingredients: Collect 2 tbsp oil, 1 chopped onion, 1 tsp garlic paste, 1 tsp cumin seeds, 200g chicken (cubed), 1 tsp red chili powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 cup coconut milk, 2 cups basmati rice, and 4 cups water.
Step 2: Heat Oil: Pour 2 tbsp oil into a pan and heat over medium heat for 1-2 minutes.
Step 3: Sauté Base: Add 1 chopped onion, 1 tsp garlic paste, and 1 tsp cumin seeds, sautéing for 5-7 minutes until golden.
Step 4: Cook Chicken: Stir in 200g chicken, 1 tsp red chili powder, and 1 tsp salt, cooking for 10-15 minutes until tender.
Step 5: Add Coconut Milk: Pour in 1 cup coconut milk, mix well, and simmer for 10 minutes until the curry thickens.
Step 6: Prepare Zeera Rice: Heat 1 tsp oil in a pot, add 1 tsp cumin seeds, toast for 30 seconds, then add 2 cups basmati rice and 4 cups water, cooking for 10-12 minutes.
Step 7: Check Consistency: Ensure the curry is creamy and the rice is fluffy; adjust seasoning if needed.
Step 8: Serve Hot: Plate the coconut chicken curry and serve with hot zeera rice.

recipeName: Chicken Biryani with Boiled Eggs and Salad
instructions: Step 1: Gather Ingredients: Collect 3 tbsp oil, 2 sliced onions, 1 tbsp ginger paste, 1 tbsp garlic paste, 2 green chilies (chopped), 200g chicken (cut into pieces), 2 chopped tomatoes, ½ cup yogurt, 1 tsp salt, 2 cups basmati rice, 4 cups water, 2 tbsp coriander (chopped), 4 eggs, and salad ingredients (cucumber, tomato, onion).
Step 2: Heat Oil: Pour 3 tbsp oil into a pot and heat over medium heat for 1-2 minutes.
Step 3: Sauté Onions: Add 2 sliced onions and sauté for 5-7 minutes until golden brown and aromatic.
Step 4: Cook Aromatics: Stir in 1 tbsp ginger paste, 1 tbsp garlic paste, and 2 green chilies, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Step 5: Brown Chicken: Add 200g chicken pieces, stirring well, and cook for 10-12 minutes until lightly browned.
Step 6: Thicken Masala: Mix in 2 chopped tomatoes, ½ cup yogurt, and 1 tsp salt, cooking for 7-10 minutes until the mixture thickens and oil separates.
Step 7: Prepare Rice and Eggs: Boil 2 cups basmati rice in 4 cups water with a pinch of salt for 8-10 minutes until half-cooked, drain; separately, boil 4 eggs for 10 minutes, peel, and slice.

Step 8: Layer and Serve: Layer the half-cooked rice over the chicken, sprinkle with 2 tbsp chopped coriander, steam for 10 minutes on low heat, then serve hot with boiled eggs and a salad of sliced cucumber, tomato, and onion.

instructions: Step 1: Gather Ingredients: Collect 2 tbsp oil, 1 sliced onion, 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste, 1 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp salt, 1 cup tomato puree, 200g paneer (cubed), ¼ cup cream, 1 tbsp butter, 2 cups basmati rice, and 4 cups water.

recipeName: Balochi Sajji Pulao with Smoked Chicken
instructions: Step 1: Gather Ingredients: Collect 500g Chicken , 2 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tbsp garlic paste, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp salt, 2 tbsp oil (for roasting), 2 cups basmati rice, 1 tsp cumin seeds, 1 tsp salt (for rice), 4 cups water, and 1 piece of charcoal (for smoking).
Step 2: Marinate Chicken: Rub  whole chicken with 2 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tbsp garlic paste, 1 tsp black pepper, and 1 tsp salt, and marinate for 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Step 3: Roast Chicken: Preheat an oven to 200°C (or use a grill), brush the chicken with 2 tbsp oil, and roast for 45-60 minutes until fully cooked and golden.
Step 4: Boil Rice: In a pot, boil 4 cups water with 1 tsp cumin seeds and 1 tsp salt, add 2 cups basmati rice, cook for 8-10 minutes until half-cooked, then drain.
Step 5: Assemble Pulao: Place the drained rice in a large pot, and position the roasted chicken on top.
Step 6: Smoke Pulao: Heat a piece of charcoal until red-hot, place it in a small metal bowl inside the pot, drizzle with 1 tsp oil to create smoke, cover tightly, and smoke for 5 minutes.
Step 7: Serve Hot: Remove the charcoal, fluff the rice, carve the chicken, and serve hot.

instructions: Step 1: Gather Ingredients: Collect 2 tbsp oil, 1 tsp cumin seeds, 1 sliced onion, 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste, 2 chopped tomatoes, 1 tsp red chili powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 cup lobia (black-eyed peas, soaked overnight), 4 cups water, 2 cups basmati rice, and 4 green chilies.

recipeName: Chicken Chapli Kabab with Roghni Naan
instructions: Step 1: Gather Ingredients: Collect 400g minced chicken, 1 small onion (finely chopped), 1 tomato (deseeded, finely chopped), 1 green chili (chopped), 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste, 1 tsp red chili powder, 1 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp salt, 2 tbsp ghee (for frying), 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp yeast, ½ cup milk, 1 tbsp sugar, and 2 tbsp ghee (for naan).

Step 4: Shape Patties: Divide the mixture into 6-8 portions, shape each into a flat, round patty about ½ inch thick.
Step 5: Shallow Fry Kababs: Heat 2 tbsp ghee in a pan over medium heat, fry the patties for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through, then drain on paper towels.
Step 6: Prepare Roghni Naan Dough: In a bowl, mix 2 cups all-purpose flour with 1 tsp yeast, ½ cup milk, 1 tbsp sugar, and a pinch of salt, knead into a soft dough, and rest for 1 hour.
Step 7: Shape and Cook Naan: Divide the dough into 4-6 balls, roll into ovals, cook on a tawa or oven (250°C) for 2-3 minutes per side until golden, then brush with 2 tbsp ghee.
Step 8: Serve Hot: Plate the hot chicken chapli kababs and serve with the warm roghni naan.

recipeName: Tandoori Keema Naan with Yogurt Chutney
instructions: Step 1: Gather Ingredients: Collect 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp yeast, ½ cup water, 1 tsp salt, 400g minced meat (beef or lamb), 1 small onion (finely chopped), 1 green chili (chopped), 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste, 1 tsp red chili powder, 1 tsp garam masala, 2 tbsp oil, 1 cup yogurt, 1 tbsp mint (chopped), and 1 tsp cumin powder.
Step 2: Prepare Naan Dough: In a bowl, mix 2 cups all-purpose flour with 1 tsp yeast, ½ cup water, and 1 tsp salt, knead into a soft dough, cover, and let it rest for 1 hour.
Step 3: Cook Keema Base: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan over medium heat, add 1 chopped onion, 1 chopped green chili, and 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste, sautéing for 5-7 minutes until onions soften.
Step 4: Finish Keema Filling: Add 400g minced meat, 1 tsp red chili powder, and 1 tsp garam masala, cooking for 15-20 minutes until the keema is dry and fully cooked, then cool slightly.
Step 5: Divide Dough: Punch down the rested dough and divide it into 4-6 equal balls.
Step 6: Stuff Naan: Roll each dough ball into a 3-inch circle, place 1-2 tbsp keema in the center, seal the edges, and gently roll out to a 6-7 inch oval.
Step 7: Cook Tandoori Naan: Heat a tawa or oven (250°C), cook each naan for 2-3 minutes per side until puffed and charred, brushing with oil or ghee for a tandoori finish.
Step 8: Make Yogurt Chutney and Serve: Mix 1 cup yogurt with 1 tbsp chopped mint, 1 tsp cumin powder, and a pinch of salt, plate the hot keema naan, and serve with yogurt chutney on the side.

instructions: Step 1: Gather Ingredients: Collect 400g chicken mince, ¼ cup cream, 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste, 1 tsp red chili powder, 1 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp salt, 2 tbsp coriander (chopped), 2 tbsp ghee (for frying), 2 cups whole wheat flour, ¾ cup water (for dough), 1 cucumber (sliced), 1 tomato (sliced), and 1 tbsp lemon juice.

Step 3: Rest Mixture: Let the kabab mixture rest for 20-30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld and the texture to firm up.
Step 4: Shape Kababs: Divide the mixture into 6-8 portions, shape each into long, cylindrical kababs, either by hand or onto skewers.
Step 5: Pan-Fry Kababs: Heat 2 tbsp ghee in a pan over medium heat, fry the kababs for 4-5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through, then drain on paper towels.

Step 7: Cook Roti: Heat a tawa over medium heat, cook each roti for 1-2 minutes per side until lightly browned and puffed.
Step 8: Assemble Salad and Serve: Toss 1 sliced cucumber and 1 sliced tomato with 1 tbsp lemon juice and a pinch of salt, plate the hot reshmi kababs with warm roti and the fresh salad on the side.
